title: Ratio measures require a denominator and ratio additivity.
body: $this cd:aggregationPolicy cd:aggregationPolicy_RatioOfSums. FILTER(!EXISTS {$this cd:denominatorExpression ?d} || !EXISTS {$this cd:additivity cd:additivity_Ratio})

title: The measure belongs to the declared analytical subject.
Grouping and filtering dimensions belong to the declared analytical subject.
Comparison kind requires exactly its reference window or target, with no competing baseline.
body: $this cd:comparisonKind ?k. FILTER((?k=cd:comparisonKind_PreviousPeriod && (!EXISTS {$this cd:referenceWindow ?r} || EXISTS {$this cd:targetValue ?v})) || (?k=cd:comparisonKind_Target && (!EXISTS {$this cd:targetValue ?v} || EXISTS {$this cd:referenceWindow ?r})) || (?k=cd:comparisonKind_None && (EXISTS {$this cd:referenceWindow ?r} || EXISTS {$this cd:targetValue ?v})))

title: Change operators require a comparison baseline.
Filter values use the dimension datatype.
Available results require a value; unavailable results cannot assert a value.
Custom panes require an approved renderer; analytical panes require a query.
A successful measurement execution requires complete source coverage through the reporting interval.
body: $this cd:executionState cd:executionState_Succeeded; cd:analyticalQuery/cd:timeContext/cd:reportWindow/cd:endsAt ?end; cd:sourceWatermark ?w. ?w cd:completeThrough ?c; cd:watermarkState ?s. FILTER(?c < ?end || ?s != cd:watermarkState_Complete)

title: Previous-period baselines must end before the report begins.
Summable measures must declare additive behavior.
